Format rxSolve and related objects as html.

Source: R/rxFormat.R
rxHtml.Rd

Format rxSolve and related objects as html.

Usage

rxHtml(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'rxSolve'
rxHtml(x, ...)

Arguments

x

rxode2 object

...

Extra arguments sent to kable

Value

html code for rxSolve object

See also

Other Utilities: rxDerived(), rxGetDefaultSerialize(), rxInv(), rxIsCurrent(), rxLock(), rxNumLoaded(), rxOmegaVarCovDeriv(), rxSuppressMsg(), rxSymInvChol(), rxTempDir()

Author

Matthew L. Fidler

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
mod <- function() {
  ini({
    tcl <- log(3)
    tv <- log(30)
  })
  model({
    cl <- exp(tcl)
    v <- exp(tv)
    d/dt(central) <- -cl / v * central
    cp <- central / v
  })
}
s <- rxSolve(mod, et(amt = 100, cmt = "central") |> et(0:4))
rxHtml(s)
}
